administrativeScope.limits: Province plus separate-city starter coverage. Municipalities/component cities and each island/waterbody still require the source-sweep inventory; this is not a completed regional inventory.

waterbodies.name: Manila Bay
waterbodies.scopeNote: One shared bay identity. The 2014-2015 NFRDI survey defines a Cavite stratum, but its station map has not been georeferenced; the source does not define current species presence, current bay boundaries, or municipal-water geometry.

waterbodies.name: Maragondon River
waterbodies.scopeNote: River identity only; monitored segments do not delimit the entire channel or sanctuary. A 2014 goby barcoding paper is a historical fish lead, but it reports conflicting putative species identities and has no adopted reach geometry; all three species-level claims remain held for independent review. GBIF's exact Maragondon River query returned zero rows, which does not establish fish absence.

waterbodies.name: Maragondon River Estuary
waterbodies.scopeNote: Primary project site name; exact tidal reach and salinity need review. Do not reuse a management-site area as the wetted estuary.

waterbodies.name: Noveleta Mangrove Area
waterbodies.scopeNote: Habitat-site lead, not a newly asserted independent lake or channel; connected-water identity and extent remain pending.

waterbodies.name: Lawa ng Tres Cruzes
waterbodies.scopeNote: Provider spelling retained; local name, hydrological kind and locality require reconciliation.

waterbodies.name: Taal Lake
waterbodies.scopeNote: Freshwater identity context only; no recent fish list, safety or fishing-access approval.

waterbodies.name: Pansipit River
waterbodies.scopeNote: Four 1933 CC0 Field Museum specimen records support four historical species-locality assertions by exact Pansipit River text. All carry institution/collection quality flags; three also carry recorded-date mismatch flags. Their shared coordinate has no uncertainty and is withheld. No exact reach, estuary, salinity, current presence, or complete river list is inferred. The river links Taal Lake to Balayan Bay; one salinity class cannot be assigned to every reach from this connection.

waterbodies.name: Pansipit River Estuary
waterbodies.scopeNote: Source project names this estuary; extent, season-specific salinity and biological claims remain unreviewed.

waterbodies.name: Balayan Bay
waterbodies.scopeNote: Source describes saline bay water; no numeric salinity or species habitat assignment is inferred.

waterbodies.name: Batangas Bay
waterbodies.scopeNote: Named NSAP study area; landing records need catch-origin review before waterbody presence.

waterbodies.name: Lagadlarin Mangrove Forest
waterbodies.scopeNote: Habitat-site name from inventory; connected waterways, salinity and extent need review. A 2024 study assesses mangrove and associate plants rather than fish; the Lagardlarin body-text spelling is not adopted as an alias. The exact Lagadlarin GBIF query returned zero rows and does not establish fish absence.

waterbodies.name: Laguna de Bay
waterbodies.scopeNote: Shared lake. One 2024 preserved specimen is reported from a fisherfolk catch and associated with Laguna de Bay; the official 2026 corrigendum corrects the locality to Brgy. Calahan, Cardona, Rizal. Article text gives no capture coordinates; its sampling-location figure is not georeferenced in the app. Basin/jurisdiction membership is broader than the lake; Cavite/Batangas/Quezon basin membership is not a lake-surface assertion.

waterbodies.name: Caliraya Reservoir
waterbodies.scopeNote: Named reservoir; GBIF's exact Lake Caliraya query returned four dated copepod specimens and no fish record, while the Caliraya Lake alias returned zero. A 2022 conference abstract reports a historical fish survey but omits its complete species list and exact field dates. Study-derived species claims remain held pending item-specific reuse and full-table review. The four GBIF records share a coordinate without uncertainty and are excluded from fish assertions and map display. Bounded text searches do not imply fish absence. No stocking record is treated as wild occurrence.

waterbodies.name: Palico-Lian River
waterbodies.scopeNote: A separate page projection shows 12 identity-and-family-reviewed rows from the 2025 survey table. Three rows remain held for source-family conflicts. The study reports three sites, but no precise site geometry, field-calendar date, whole-river presence or measured salinity is adopted.

waterbodies.name: Tayabas River
waterbodies.scopeNote: A 2013 study reports three sampled stream sections on Tayabas River, Quezon, during wet and dry seasons of 2010. Exact reaches, municipal crosswalk, salinity and geometry remain unreviewed.

coverageRules.inventoryMeaning: Named source-backed research leads, not a verified catch list or complete regional waterbody census.
coverageRules.kindMeaning: Hydrological/habitat type interpreted from source labels for review; habitat-site entries are kept distinguishable from water channels.
coverageRules.salinityMeaning: Source-context classification only where explicitly supported; unknown remains unknown. Estuary naming alone does not establish a measured brackish value.
coverageRules.administrativeMeaning: Source-described associations; no point-in-polygon or legal boundary claim. Shared waters have one stable research identity and many associations.
coverageRules.speciesMeaning: No names from a water-quality page, landing-center list, stocking report or national checklist become local wild-presence evidence automatically.
coverageRules.completionMeaning: This starter snapshot does not satisfy regional baseline-reviewed status.
